    "http://127.0.0.1:8025/api/v1/emails/EMAIL_ID_PLACEHOLDER",
    headers={"content-type":"application/json"},

)

snippets.ruby:
require "net/http"

uri = URI("http://127.0.0.1:8025/api/v1/emails/EMAIL_ID_PLACEHOLDER")
request = Net::HTTP::Patch.new(uri)
request["content-type"] = "application/json"
request.body = "{\n  \"is_read\": true,\n  \"tags\": [\n    \"signup\",\n    \"qa\"\n  ]\n}"
response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port) { |http| http.request(request) }
